questions.stem: How does regular exercise training affect muscle cells?

options.text: Muscle cells stop using oxygen altogether
Muscle cells switch permanently to anaerobic respiration
Muscle cells develop more mitochondria and a better blood supply

questions.explanation: Regular training causes muscle cells to develop more mitochondria (increasing aerobic capacity) and a better capillary network (improving oxygen delivery). This means trained athletes can exercise longer before switching to anaerobic respiration.
